about: Known screen problems (axe serious/critical, sideways scroll on a phone, page title not the menu label), by screen and check, so they do not fail the run on day one. Each line is a debt: fix the screen, then delete the line. Rebuild: E2E_KNOWN_UPDATE=1 npm run e2e, then node e2e/scripts/known-issues.mjs.
